slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“陈神医，我刚才好像听人说你蹲过监狱？”
龙天正端着酒杯，看似随意地问了一句。
他这一句话，让气氛瞬间凝固，洛千凝黛眉紧蹙，甚是不满。
姬紫叶对着龙天正不停使眼色，可对方却熟视无睹。
相反，许斌却在一旁忍不住偷笑起来。
这下有好戏看了。
“嗯。”
陈凡点点头，对于龙天正的提问也不隐瞒。
“为什么入狱的？方便说说吗？”
龙天正好奇地接着问道。
“有个姓韩的畜生对我妹动手动脚，我一怒之下动了手，就被关了进去。”
陈凡实话实说。
虽然没有明确说出对方的名字，但听他说姓韩的，再加上刚才庄园外的冲突，大家也知道那个人就是韩根硕了。
“有你这么一位有担当的哥哥，你妹真的太幸福了。”
姬紫叶像是想起了什么，感慨地说道。
“这叫有担当？这叫愚蠢好吗！”
龙天正一脸不屑，接着说道，“聪明人办事之前都会经过大脑的，首先要明白自己有几斤几两，而不是像个莽夫一样，冲动行事，懂吗？”
龙天正看似在反驳姬紫叶，却明显是在骂陈凡四肢发达头脑简单。
“龙副总指挥，如果你的妹妹或是家人遇到这种情况，不知道你会怎么做呢？坐视不管吗？”
陈凡问道。

“当然不可能，我一定会让那个浑蛋付出惨重的代价！”
龙天正说话之间一脸杀伐之气，绝对是久经战场磨炼出来的。
不过，他回答之后，马上话锋一转：“可我跟你不一样，我是绝对不会让自己被抓进监狱的，因为我有足够的实力。”
“如果像你一样实力不足的话，就我一定会首先去想怎么让自己强大起来，而不是因为一时冲动把自己毁掉。”
“作为男人，自身足够强大才是重中之重，歪门邪道或许能让自己风光一时，可终有露出马脚的那一天。”
龙天正意有所指，嘲讽意味非常重。
许斌在一旁隔岸观火，笑的嘴都快咧到耳根了，他听的明白，这分明就是在说陈凡是个哗众取宠的小丑！
等他露出马脚的时候，就该完蛋了！
姬紫叶眉头紧皱不停观察着洛千凝的表情，作为女人，直觉告诉她洛千凝对陈凡非常有好感。
而贵为洛家大小姐的她，可不是那么好骗的。
不过在听了龙天正的话，洛千凝并没有急着表态，她像是置若罔闻，都懒得跟龙天正解释，把舞台留给了陈凡自由发挥。
“洛妹妹对他就这么有信心？难道这个陈凡还有什么杀手锏不成？”
姬紫叶好奇心被彻底勾了起来。
面对龙天正的讽刺，陈凡只是淡淡一笑：“龙副总指挥说的很对，从前我的确是太冲动了，没有考虑周全，不过我并不后悔，如果上天给我重来一次的机会，我还是会竭尽所能保护我妹妹的周全。”
“我也同意你之前说的，要给那个浑蛋一个惨重的教训！”
“所以死太便宜他了，我要的是让他生不如死！”
原本并没有将陈凡放在眼里的龙天正，此刻忽然从对方眼中感受到了一股凌厉的杀气！
只是一瞬，却令人窒息！
龙天正走神了几秒，便又马上恢复了镇定。
“狠话谁不会说，关键还是要看有没有实力，不然死的是谁可说不准，男人就该顶天立地，总不能靠女人保护吧。”

龙天正激将道。
“呵呵，多谢龙副总指挥的提醒，不过我既然敢说这话，那自然是有自己的底气，龙副总指挥有时间关注我，其实倒不如多关心自己的身体。”
content_en:
"Miracle Doctor Chen, I just heard someone say that you have been in prison?"
Long Tian was holding a wine glass and asked seemingly casually.
His words made the atmosphere freeze instantly. Luo Qianning frowned, feeling very dissatisfied.
Ji Ziye kept winking at Long Tianzheng, but the other party turned a blind eye.
On the contrary, Xu Bin couldn't help but chuckle.
There's something good to watch now.
"Yeah."
Chen Fan nodded and did not hide anything from Long Tianzheng's question.
"Why are you in jail? Can you tell me?"
Long Tianzheng asked curiously.
"There was a beast named Han who touched my sister. I moved my hands in anger and was locked up."
Chen Fan told the truth.
Although the other party's name was not clearly stated, everyone knew that that person was Han Geunshuo after hearing that his surname was Han, coupled with the conflict outside the manor just now.
"Your sister is so lucky to have such a responsible brother like you."
Ji Ziye seemed to have remembered something and said with emotion.
"Is this called being responsible? Is this called being stupid?"
Long Tianzheng looked disdainful and continued, "Smart people go through their brains before doing anything. They must first understand how much they weigh, instead of acting impulsively like a reckless man. Do you understand?"
Long Tianzheng seemed to be refuting Ji Ziye, but he was obviously scolding Chen Fan for his strong limbs and simple mind.
"Deputy Commander Long, if your sister or family members encountered this situation, I wonder what you would do? Just sit back and do nothing?"
Chen Fan asked.
"Of course it's impossible. I will definitely make that bastard pay a heavy price!"
Long Tianzheng had a murderous look on his face as he spoke, which must have been tempered by long experience in the battlefield.
However, after he answered, he immediately changed the topic: "But I am different from you. I will never let myself be arrested and thrown into prison, because I have enough strength."
"If I am weak like you, I will definitely think about how to make myself stronger first, instead of destroying myself on impulse."
"As a man, the most important thing is to be strong enough. You may be successful for a while through crooked ways, but there will be a day when you are exposed."
Long Tian meant something, and the meaning of ridicule was very heavy.
Xu Bin was watching the fire from the other side, grinning almost to his ears. He understood clearly that this was clearly saying that Chen Fan was a clown trying to please others!
When he shows his weakness, it will be over!
Ji Ziye frowned and kept observing Luo Qianning's expression. As a woman, she intuitively told her that Luo Qianning had a great liking for Chen Fan.
As the eldest lady of the Luo family, she is not so easy to deceive.
However, after listening to Long Tianzheng's words, Luo Qianning was not in a hurry to express her position. She seemed to turn a deaf ear and was too lazy to explain to Long Tianzheng, leaving the stage for Chen Fan to express himself freely.
"Sister Luo has so much confidence in him? Doesn't this Chen Fan have any trump cards?"
Ji Ziye's curiosity was completely aroused.
Facing Long Tianzheng's sarcasm, Chen Fan just smiled faintly: "Deputy Commander Long is right. I was indeed too impulsive in the past and did not think carefully. However, I have no regrets. If God gives me a chance to do it again, I will still do my best to protect my sister."
"I also agree with what you said before, we must teach that bastard a hard lesson!"
"So death is too cheap for him. What I want is to make his life worse than death!"
Long Tianzheng, who had not taken Chen Fan seriously at first, suddenly felt a fierce murderous aura from the other man's eyes!
It was just a moment, but it was suffocating!
Long Tianzheng was distracted for a few seconds and then immediately regained his composure.
"Who wouldn't say harsh words? The key is to see whether you have strength, otherwise you can't tell who will die. Men should stand upright and cannot rely on women to protect them."
Long Tianzheng said.
"Haha, thank you Deputy Commander Long for the reminder, but IIf you dare to say this, you must have your own confidence. Deputy Commander Long has time to pay attention to me, so he might as well pay more attention to his own body. "
